source.title: Ideal portrait of Alexander the Great as Helios (plaster cast of a Hellenistic marble)
source.attribution: Alexander the Great as Helios, plaster cast after a Hellenistic marble. 3D scan: SMK - Statens Museum for Kunst, Royal Cast Collection (open.smk.dk), public domain.

frame.units: 1.0 = chin-to-crown head height (vertical); source units per head = 63.0250
frame.axes: +Y up = vertical turn axis; +Z = measured gaze (a camera on +Z at eye height is stared at); +X = Y x Z = the figure's own left. L/R in anchor names = the figure's own left/right.
frame.origin: head centre: halfway between chin and crown, on the turn axis through the neck between the ears
frame.restoreCastPosture: rotate head-space geometry about +X by -6.000 deg to restore the cast's own vertical (the gaze then rises 6.00 deg above horizontal)

torso.note: forward/left: horizontal directions the chest faces / its own left (from the cross-section above the cut); neckAxisUp: neck direction fitted through neck cross-sections under the jaw. shoulderL/R are the highest points 0.34-0.42 to either side of the neck along torso.left (where the cast is cut narrower, the extreme of what exists); neckBase is the neck axis at the shoulder line.

bake.ao: channel 0: ambient visibility, 48 cosine-weighted rays per vertex, mean normalised free distance up to 0.25 head units (1 = open, 0 = enclosed)
bake.cavity: channel 1: signed multi-scale curvature, 0.5 = flat, < 0.5 crevice (curl undercuts, eye corners, lid creases, nostrils), > 0.5 ridge/edge; value = 0.5 + 0.5*tanh(c/2.5), c in robust-sigma units
bake.thickness: channel 2: inward free distance along -normal (7-ray 22 deg cone) / 0.12 head units; low = thin (nose wings, ears, lids, curl tips, lips): use for subsurface translucency
bake.skin: channel 3: 1 = broad smooth carved skin (face, neck, chest), 0 = hair/beard/deep carving; use for polish/gloss and SSS strength

diadem.ring: anchors.diademRing = [centre, unit normal (up/back), radius]: circle fitted through the 7 ray-hole mouths (radial residual max 0.0110, out-of-plane max 0.0208 head units). The fillet runs high over the brow and drops toward the nape.
diadem.holes: anchors.rayHoles: mouths of the drilled attachment holes along the lower edge of the fillet, ordered from the figure's right (-) to left (+); rayHoleNormals = local surface normal of the band at each hole (the drill axis, roughly); rayHoleAzimuthDeg measured on the ring from the front (+Z), + = figure's left. Depths (head units): 0.0131, 0.0124, 0.0148, 0.0024, 0.0037, 0.0059, 0.0107. None at the back (the cast is unfinished there).
diadem.socket: anchors.crownSocket: mouth of the larger rectangular socket on top of the skull (depth 0.035), centre of the original radiate crown / nimbus fixing.

notes: Gaze per eye measured relative to the facial symmetry plane (deg, +yaw = figure's left, +pitch = up): {"eyeL": {"yaw": 11.29, "pitch": -16.14}, "eyeR": {"yaw": -7.48, "pitch": -15.45}}.
Facial symmetry plane residual 0.0048 head units (mirror-ICP on the face).
Crop: one horizontal plane at y = -0.92, capped (flat cap facing -Y); keep it out of frame or in shadow.
Turn: yaw about +Y through the origin. The 90-degree turn starts with the camera on the figure's RIGHT (-X side, face pointing screen-right) and ends on +Z (stared at).

Ears: earL ESTIMATED: ear hidden by hair/beard; outer surface point beside the ear position estimated 0.318 behind the eyeball midpoint along the facial axis (ratio measured on david); earR ESTIMATED: ear hidden by hair/beard; outer surface point beside the ear position estimated 0.318 behind the eyeball midpoint along the facial axis (ratio measured on david)
Head units: 1.0 = 63.025 source units (raw STL units).

Blank (uncarved) eyes. Yaw = mean of the two eyeball caps (1.9 deg). The Hellenistic upturned gaze measured 6.0 deg above horizontal by visual judgement (renders at camera pitch 0..20 deg; the lid-aperture geometry is biased by the overhanging upper lid). CHOICE: levelled, so the blank eyes meet the lens at eye height for the final stare; the upward pathos remains in the face and the tilt of the head. frame.restoreCastPosture gives the original upturn back.
Scanner orange-peel removed from broad, low-curvature skin (cheeks, brow, neck) by a masked Taubin smooth; lids, lips, nostrils and curls are masked out and stay crisp.
The bust and nose tip are restorations (SMK). The bust back is hollow with a support post inside (only seen from behind).
